levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All five reports have one row for every lettered dimension on the drawing with its tolerance, a measured value or thread check, a tool, a P or F, a verdict that agrees with the rows, and the date.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All five reports present with one or two missing entries, or one verdict that disagrees with its rows.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three or four reports filled, or five with many missing entries or missing dimensions.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Two reports or fewer.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every required dimension and every tolerance matches what the drawing gives for that letter.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One or two required dimensions or tolerances do not match the drawing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three to five do not match the drawing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Most required dimensions or tolerances do not match the drawing.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every row names a tool that can measure that feature to the tolerance the drawing gives.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One or two rows name a tool that cannot read to that tolerance or cannot reach that feature.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Tools missing from, or wrong on, three or more rows.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No inspection tools named.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every row marked F has a remark saying which way it is off and a likely cause: the tool, the material, how the part was held, or how the machine moves. On a part with no F, the row with the largest percent error has that remark instead.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every F has a remark, but the cause is general rather than one of those four.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some F rows have a remark and some do not.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No remarks on any F row, or no remarks at all.

levels.label: Complete
levels.short: All judged, creativity on P1, P5
levels.descriptor: Every report rates deburring and says where the part is sharp, burred, or clean, and P1 and P5 carry a creativity comment.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One deburring or creativity comment missing, or one that names no place on the part.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three deburring or creativity comments missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Deburring and creativity are not judged.
